caption:
Can someone explain this? 😤
You can do everything right for months, pay on time, keep balances low, and the score moves 5 points.
Miss one payment and it can drop like a rock.
Why does building feel so slow and breaking feel so fast?
Has this happened to you?
first_comment: Did your score ever drop way more than you expected? What happened? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Slow to build, fast to break. Agree? Tell us below. @creditscoretruths

card.headline: Why does a score take months to build and one slip to dent?
